title: Mission-Aligned Learning-Informed Control of Autonomous Systems: Formulation and Foundations
abstract: arXiv:2507.04356v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Research, innovation and practical capital investment have been increasing rapidly toward the realization of autonomous physical agents. This includes industrial and service robots, unmanned aerial vehicles, embedded control devices, and a number of other realizations of cybernetic/mechatronic implementations of intelligent autonomous devices. In this paper, we consider a stylized version of robotic care, which would normally involve a two-level Reinforcement Learning procedure that trains a policy for both lower level physical movement decisions as well as higher level conceptual tasks and their sub-components. In order to deliver greater safety and reliability in the system, we present the general formulation of this as a two-level optimization scheme which incorporates control at the lower level, and classical planning at the higher level, integrated with a capacity for learning. translated_title: 面向任务对齐的学习知情自主系统控制：形式化与基础
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2507.04356v3 公告类型：替代交叉 摘要：随着自主物理智能体的实现，研究、创新和实际资本投资正在迅速增加。这包括工业和服务机器人、无人机、嵌入式控制设备以及智能自主设备的控制论/机电一体化实现的其他多种形式。在本文中，我们考虑了一个简化的机器人护理版本，这通常涉及一个两级强化学习过程，该过程训练策略以同时处理低级物理运动决策以及高级概念任务及其子组件。为了在系统中实现更高的安全性和可靠性，我们将其提出为一个两级优化方案的一般形式化，该方案在低级整合控制，在高级整合经典规划，并集成学习能力。这种多种方法的协同整合...
tldr: 本文提出了一种两级优化框架，将低级控制与高级规划相结合并集成学习能力，以增强自主系统在机器人护理等任务中的安全性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-level optimization framework that integrates low-level control with high-level planning and learning capabilities to enhance safety and reliability of autonomous systems in tasks like robotic care.
